decisions.reason: The same source message already introduces the separate Wix website and account architecture; the routing change requires no additional candidate-state update.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY establishing separate Wix accounts and payment setups, followed by RESUME; the routing details add no further payout-state change.
The same message already updates the candidate with separate Wix accounts and location-specific reporting, while its booking and calendar isolation facts remain valid unchanged.
The master site continues to bring the brand, locations, and information together; location-selection routing is independently represented by the source Requirement.
Routing current visitors to separate location sites does not change the requirement to support integration of future locations.
The routing decision does not change the SMASH ROOM brand name or its applicable site contexts.
The separate-site routing architecture does not alter the visual reference, layout style, or general navigation-style requirements.
The booking platform remains Wix; separate location ownership and routing are already represented by the architecture, routing, and business-data isolation Requirements.
The source does not establish any change to the requirement to preserve Bay Area search rankings during migration.
